categories.rationale: Fixes an assertion failure in debug builds and restores JSON-RPC 2.0 spec compliance on malformed requests. In debug builds, an Assume check fails and crashes the node on authenticated malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, while release builds return HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 200.
